summary: Added an application-layer URL normalizer that preserves unaffected URL components while lowercasing the scheme and host, removing HTTP/HTTPS default ports, and stripping case-insensitive utm_ query parameters.
rationale: No current file contents were provided, so the existing link-creation flow could not be safely edited without risking its existing behavior. The normalizer is provided as a focused application-layer utility; it does not change API contracts or persistence.
content:
## Implementation note

The repository contents were not included in the input, so this change adds the normalizer without editing or guessing the existing `LinkService` implementation. It must be called from link creation after validation and before persistence to apply to newly saved links.
